summary: Recursively processes a node whose children are reached at this+0x44 and this+0x4C. Recurses into the first child whenever it is non-null, and into the second child only when it is non-null and the a2 flag is set; either recursion returning -1 aborts the whole walk with -1. When the node has a linked-list head at this+0x204, iterates the list following the +16 next pointer while sub_54CA00 returns zero, returning -1 as soon as sub_54CA00 returns non-zero. Returns 0 when the list head is null, the walk reaches a null next pointer, or no error is reported. Called from sub_544740.

Advance to the next list node by reading the pointer at +16 of the current node.
When the next pointer at +16 is null, end the walk and return 0.
Return -1 when sub_54CA00 returns non-zero on the current list node.
Return 0 when no child recursion or list element reported an error.
